title: What does rising sign mean?
old_caption:
Your rising sign is the one coming up over the eastern horizon when you were born, and it changes about every two hours.
In astrology it's your first impression, the front door to your chart.

title: How do you fight fair?
old_caption: Fighting fair starts with remembering it's you two against the problem, not each other. One topic at a time, no name-calling, and breaks are allowed. Same team, always.

title: What's a Saturn return?
old_caption:
Saturn takes about 29.5 years to orbit the Sun, returning around ages 27 to 30. Astrologers read it as a growing-up chapter.
It's a check-in, not a deadline for love. You have time.

title: Why does self-worth come first?
old_caption:
Making a list of why they should like you? Start with why you like you.
Know your worth and you'll choose who matches it. A slow reply doesn't measure your value. Date from full, not empty.

title: What's your 7th house?
old_caption: In astrology, the 7th house is the part of your chart linked to partnership. It describes, it never picks your person. Think of it as a room in your sky, not a reservation.

title: What is a sun sign, actually?
old_caption: Your sun sign is where the Sun appeared along the zodiac on the day you were born. In astrology it stands for your core self. A cute way to think of it: your birthday's address in the sky.

title: What's synastry?
old_caption: Synastry compares two birth charts to explore how two people interact. It's a conversation starter, not a match score. The real test is two people actually talking.

title: Is my sign wrong now?
old_caption:
Heard your sign changed? Earth's axis wobbles slowly, so the stars behind the Sun have shifted. Western astrology ties signs to the seasons; sidereal ties them to the stars.
Your sign didn't go anywhere.

title: How is trust actually built?
old_caption: Trust isn't built by one big gesture. It's showing up when you said you would, keeping little promises and being the same person in private. Small, steady, repeated.

title: What does your Venus sign say?
old_caption: In astrology, your Venus sign is linked to how you love and show affection. Fun to read, but there's an easier shortcut: ask your person how they like to be loved.
